item.title: fix(backend): fall back gracefully when the Dynarmic native library fails to load
item.description:
Problem

The static initializer of DynarmicFactory only catches IOException, but a failed dlopen throws UnsatisfiedLinkError (an Error, not an Exception). When the packaged natives are incompatible with the running platform — e.g. a dylib rebuilt with a newer toolchain loaded by an older loader — the exception escapes the static block, the whole class fails to initialize, and every later reference throws NoClassDefFoundError. The fallbackUnicorn chain never gets a chance to run.

Reproduced on CI: macOS arm64 runners fail to load the packaged osx_arm64/libdynarmic.dylib and both backend-matrix jobs go red the moment any test touches the class.

Fix

Catch Throwable instead and record a flag; newBackendInternal throws when loading failed. BackendFactory.newBackend already catches Throwable and returns null for fallbackUnicorn=true, so createBackend moves on to the next factory (usually Unicorn2Factory) and the backend degrades gracefully.

单文件小改：static 块 catch (Throwable) 并记录 nativeLoadFailed 旗标，装载失败时 newBackendInternal 抛出，由父类已有的 fallbackUnicorn 回退链接管（返回 null → createBackend 尝试下一工厂），后端不可用时优雅降级而非类初始化中毒。
item.author: memoriaru

item.title: ApkFile.getPackageName: tolerate a malformed/minimal resources.arsc
item.description:
Problem. createDalvikVM() → BaseVM.findLibrary() → ApkFile.getPackageName() calls apk-parser's getApkMeta(), whose full parse reads the resource table. An APK whose resources.arsc is the minimal stub aapt2 emits for a resource-less app makes that parse throw:

java.nio.BufferUnderflowException
  at net.dongliu.apk.parser.parser.ResourceTableParser.readChunkHeader
  ...
  at com.github.unidbg.linux.android.dvm.apk.ApkFile.getPackageName(ApkFile.java:97)
  at com.github.unidbg.linux.android.dvm.BaseVM.findLibrary(BaseVM.java:276)

BufferUnderflowException is a RuntimeException, so neither the ParserException nor the IOException catch handles it, and loading the APK fails outright.

Fix. The package name is a literal attribute on the <manifest> element and needs no resource table. Catch the RuntimeException and read it straight from the binary AndroidManifest.xml (via the existing getFileData, a plain zip read); rethrow only if even that yields nothing. Normal APKs are unaffected — the fallback runs only on the exception path. One file, no API change.

Validation. The added binary-manifest reader was unit-tested standalone against stub-arsc APKs and recovers the real package name (e.g. re.lab.app01); ApkFile.java compiles against apk-parser 2.6.10. I couldn't run unidbg's full test suite locally — happy to adjust.

Found while using unidbg to emulate a .so in an APK that had no resources.

item.title: 增加支持在LinuxModule注册新的符号
item.description:
背景: 在模拟一个elf的文件执行时,该elf需要用到libdl.so的dlvsym函数,但我看了下unidbg带的so中仅支持dlsym函数，于是我手动实现该函数，并通过registerSvc注册进SvcMemory,再通过registerSymbol函数注册到libdl的Module里。

问题:当我注册进去后发现, elf中依旧找不到dlvsym函数，而我尝试通过module.findSymbolByName()和memory.dlsym()去寻找，依旧找不到dlvsym函数。

发现:我看了一下代码，对于系统库的LinuxMoudle而言,发现findSymbolByName仅从缓存和elf文件结构中寻找符号，而registerSymbol函数仅将符号添加到hook表，也就是说registerSymbol实际上只支持对elf文件中的符号进行hook(替换)，而无法添加符号函数。

解决:我认为如果仅是对现有符号进行hook，这非真正意义上的注册符号，所以我认为registerSymbol除了hook，应该还支持进行增加符号。

item.title: 修复在threadDispatcher启用时，socket相关的读取造成的死锁问题
item.description:
在threadDispatcherEnabled时，由于使用抢先式调度，会导致socketpair在其中一个线程在接收时，持续占用调度，导致永远无法接收到发送线程的信息。

同理，由于ppoll没有考虑io是否有信息可读，会导致线程持续卡死在后接的recv中，导致实际运行逻辑与实际不符，同时如果其他线程正在同一socket准备发送请求，也会造成死锁。

详细样例可见本fork的master分支
